comment: Deployed OpenHands in our Kubernetes cluster for automated triage of Dependabot alerts. The Docker sandbox isolation is rock solid, and native MCP support made custom database tooling a breeze.
Impressive terminal loop and Git PR generation. Token consumption can spike on deep directory scans if you do not customize the ignore rules, but the planning accuracy is superb.
Devin solved a complex race condition in our distributed event pipeline that three senior developers struggled to reproduce. The managed cloud environment completely removes setup overhead.
Stagehand replaced 4,000 lines of brittle Playwright XPath selectors with 20 semantic actions. The self-healing DOM capability survived a complete site redesign without breaking our scraper.
